Single firmness

Bio Support

Single-firmness natural latex regulation

A one-layer, seven-zone organic latex topper that upgrades the mattress you already have.

Why it exists

It smooths hard spots and tired mattress behaviour on spring, foam, hybrid or latex mattresses.

Who it suits

You know the firmness you need and want to improve your current bed without replacing it.

How it differs

  • Bio Support Dual puts a softer layer over a firmer one.
  • A thicker Bio Support gives a stronger correction: 8 cm light, 14 cm the most.

Dual firmness

Bio Support Dual

Two latex layers, regulated comfort

Two equal, non-glued layers of organic Dunlop latex: the lower layer regulates support, the upper layer adapts to the body.

Why it exists

It removes the soft-or-firm dilemma: softness on the surface, inside a support regulation.

Who it suits

You hesitate between two firmness levels.

How it differs

  • Bio Support is one firmness throughout.
  • Latex Topper for Partners splits firmness side to side, not top to bottom.

Partners

Latex Topper for Partners

One shared topper, a firmness for each side

Two separate organic Dunlop latex sections, one Medium and one Firm, under one shared 2 cm latex balancing layer.

Why it exists

Each partner sleeps with the regulation their body needs; the shared layer reduces the feel of the centre gap.

Who it suits

Two people with different comfort requirements sharing one bed, from Double size upwards.

How it differs

  • Bio Support Dual changes firmness from top to bottom, for one sleeper.
  • Mattress for Partners is the complete two-mattress system.
